visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals, two women and one man, stand in a brightly lit indoor mall hallway before a large silver statue of a muscular figure's lower half. The central woman wears a black lace jumpsuit, the left woman a gray top, and the man a black tee. They begin rhythmic movements and synchronized gestures towards the camera. (2) The trio performs a series of synchronized hip sways and arm crosses, moving in time with an unseen rhythm. Background shoppers walk through the mall corridors, which are decorated with purple neon signage and glass storefronts. The polished tile floor reflects the overhead spotlights and the chrome sculpture. (3) The camera zooms in slightly as the central dancer leads with intricate hand gestures and a fluid body wave. Her companions follow her lead with sharp, mirrored movements. The scene ends with a final group pose as they smile towards the camera, the background crowds continuing to move through the venue.
